insights
Perspectives on embedded insurance, vertical software, and growth.
Explore expert insights, industry trends, product strategy, and practical guidance for software platforms looking to create new revenue streams, strengthen customer experiences, and stay ahead of what’s next.
 Evaluating Embedded Insurance Partners for Vertical SaaS 
Oct 6, 2026
Embedded protection creates fresh growth that’s uniquely relevant to vertical software platforms. But the right coverage is about more than the insurance products themselves—it’s about finding a partner who deeply understands how your vertical works. Here’s why the right partner is crucial.
 How Long Does it Take to Integrate Embedded Insurance for Vertical SaaS? 
Embedding protection adds immediate value for your vertical SaaS platform, but how long does it take implement? See how Vertical Insure embeds coverage quickly.
read more 
 When AI Makes Features Easier to Build, What Can You Do To Stay Irreplaceable? 
AI is changing how software gets built, making it easier for competitors to launch new features and close product gaps. As differentiation shifts beyond software alone, platforms are finding new ways to create value, strengthen customer relationships, and unlock scalable growth.
read more 
 Your Customers Aren’t Asking for Embedded Insurance (But They Shouldn’t Have To) 
A lack of demand does not signal a lack of opportunity. When platforms object that their customers aren’t asking for embedded insurance, they’re missing the point: If customers have to ask for it, you’ve already missed the opportunity.
read more 
 The Better Tuition Refund Protection Option for School Administrators 
Tuition refund protection hasn’t changed in 50 years, but now your options have. Whether or not your school’s platform offers embedded coverage, schools can now partner with Vertical Insure to offer families more flexibility, broader coverage, and 100% payouts.
read more 
 Why “Cancel For Any Reason” Protection Doesn’t Work for Youth Sports 
After working with thousands of youth sports organizations, we’ve seen how refund protection impacts teams, rosters, and revenue. Here’s why “Cancel For Any Reason” coverage often creates more problems than it solves in youth sports.
read more 
 Vertical SaaS Success: 4 Reasons Platforms are Moving Toward Embedded Insurance 
Vertical SaaS platforms are turning to embedded insurance to unlock new revenue and remove friction at checkout. Built directly into existing workflows, it boosts customer confidence, differentiation, and long-term retention.
read more 
 Tuition Insurance For K-12 Schools: What’s Working, What’s Broken, and How to Fix It 
Tuition insurance plays an important role in protecting families and school budgets when a student withdraws, but the way it is delivered today creates unnecessary administrative burden and confusion.
read more 
 How Embedded Insurance Fixes What’s Broken in the Insurance Industry: A Guide for Vertical SaaS Leaders 
Traditional insurance frustrates customers with manual forms, slow claims, and confusing workflows. Embedded insurance fixes this by living inside the software customers already use, transforming protection into a seamless digital experience.
read more 
 Embedded Insurance Explained: 5 Key Differences Every SaaS Leader Should Know 
Traditional insurance adds friction, confusion, and drop-off points. Embedded insurance simplifies the experience by meeting customers in their existing workflow, driving conversions and loyalty through seamless protection.
read more
